content.fact_text: Strict TypeScript compiler configuration for the real-time fraud detection engine.

provenance_data.behaviour: Configures the TypeScript compiler for the fraud detection engine with strict type checking, ES2022 compatibility, and specific node16 module resolution, ensuring high-reliability and memory-safe production builds.
provenance_data.utility: Provides the mandatory compilation contract for the high-throughput, type-safe production-grade system.

content.source_code:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "node16",
    "moduleResolution": "node16",
    "strict": true,
    "noImplicitAny": true,
    "strictNullChecks": true,
    "strictFunctionTypes": true,
    "strictBindCallApply": true,
    "strictPropertyInitialization": true,
    "noImplicitThis": true,
    "alwaysStrict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "declaration": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "removeComments": false,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true
  },
  "include": [
    "src/**/*"
  ],
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules",
    "dist",
    "**/*.spec.ts",
    "**/*.test.ts"
  ]
}
